strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct the Shpitser--Pearl anchors throughout: use Definition 6 and Theorem 4 for hedge nonidentifiability, and Theorem 6 plus Corollary 2 for ID failure and completeness.

Specify whether Pobs is rational/algebraic input with an encoding and isolating data, or give TCF an exact-real oracle and report the CAD computation relative to that oracle; update the size parameter and termination claim consistently.

Add one fully worked non-root-control member of the EIPFD family, including the exact delayed-selection front-door functional and explicit demonstrations that both Proposition 4 and the root-control certificate fail.
Separate the graphical-completeness theorem from the QE decision wrapper by stating the exact compiler invariant that forces a colored hedge from the first divergent recursion state.
